w1-completion-contract.title: A spine-only crew that finishes must be recorded as finished
w1-completion-contract.imperative: The cold reviewer dispatched a real spine-only crew: it drove its spine to done, released the lease, exited 0 -- and run_crew.py recorded status failed, result_present false. You moved a crew's INPUT to the spine and left its COMPLETION CONTRACT a document. main() still hard-requires --result and CrewBackend.verify judges purely on that file, while the new prompt never mentions a result artifact. Judge a spine-only dispatch on its bound spine reaching a terminal state instead, and make --result optional in that case. That is the epic's own thesis rather than the smaller patch of naming a file in the prompt. Then fix the test that hid this: SpineOnlyDispatchTests::test_main_cli_spine_only_dispatch_succeeds passes fake_launch(..., write_result_at=...), so the harness writes the artifact the real crew is never told to write -- it passes for a reason that does not exist in production. Name the replacement test test_spine_only_success_is_not_recorded_failed and do not let it manufacture its own precondition.

postconditions.statement: spine-only completion is judged on the spine, pinned by at least three passing tests

check.command: test $(python -m pytest -q tests/test_crew_launcher.py -k SpineOnlyCompletion --collect-only 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::') -ge 3 && env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_ENGINE NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_crew_launcher.py -k SpineOnlyCompletion

w2-hook-portable.title: The waive denial must not fail open off this machine
w2-hook-portable.imperative: Measured by the reviewer: a PreToolUse hook whose command cannot run lets the tool call through silently. crew_settings_json emits the literal python3 -c '...', so on a host where python3 is not the name, a crew CAN waive its own check and nothing says so. The one mechanism whose whole job is to refuse has a hidden fallback to permitting. run_crew.py is itself a running Python process, so it needs no probe: emit shlex.quote(sys.executable). Add shell: bash to the hook entry -- the repo's own .claude/settings.json sets it on all four of its entries, and without it the single-quoted inline program does not survive a non-POSIX parse. Replace the bare assert guarding WAIVE_DENY_REASON with assert_shell_safe_command(), which already exists and raises; a bare assert is stripped under python -O. Read install_constellation.py::build_hook_command first -- it already documents this exact rule in its own words -- and cite #539 in a comment at the site.

postconditions.statement: the emitted hook command names a real interpreter and a shell

check.command: python -c "import sys,json,shlex;sys.path.insert(0,'scripts');import run_crew;h=json.loads(run_crew.crew_settings_json())['hooks']['PreToolUse'][0]['hooks'][0];sys.exit(0 if shlex.split(h['command'])[0] not in ('python3','python','py') and h.get('shell')=='bash' else 1)"

postconditions.statement: the shell-safety guard raises rather than asserting
the portability fix is pinned by at least two passing tests

why_trail.why: run_crew.py judges spine-only completion on checklist_engine.active_id(spine)==None via new spine_terminal(); --result is optional in CrewSpec/build_entry/finalize_from_exit_code when --spine is given; replaced the hiding test with SpineOnlyCompletionContractTests (5 tests, none write a result artifact).

crew_settings_json now emits shlex.quote(sys.executable) instead of a hardcoded python3, adds shell:bash to the hook entry, and calls install_constellation.assert_shell_safe_command() on the composed command (cites #539); the WAIVE_DENY_REASON apostrophe guard now raises CrewLaunchError instead of a bare assert. Pinned by HookPortabilityTests (3 tests).

Full suite green (2556 passed, 1 skipped, 1101 subtests); map/INDEX.md regenerated for the entity-count drift; IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md written from the implementer template with Workflow Feedback, confirming the new tests would have caught the failed-status bug (verified red against pre-fix commit 6fc83013).
